evals.name: setup-env
evals.prompt: Set up the ColumnShard bug hunt environment on this machine.
evals.expected_output: detect_env.py ran with --main set to the current harness and model; the env file lists the probed reviewers with ok or the failure reason; the current model is marked same_as_main.
expectations: detect_env.py was run with --main HARNESS=MODEL of the current session
~/.config/ydb-columnshard-bug-hunt/env.json exists and lists reviewers with ok, same_as_main and error fields
subagent_models lists the models the subagent tool offers
The answer names the default reviewer, or says that subagents of the main harness will be used
Every failed reviewer is reported with the reason from its error text
